authority: Rowan-authorised first executable Universal Horizon Library seam

records.title: Universal Horizon is the Library
records.summary: Universal Horizon is a durable open knowledge commons for scientific, research, mythic, creative, and architectural records. Harmony proposes relationships across records. Wayglass supplies presence, continuity, and return. Hermes supplies bounded research work. No layer silently becomes another.
unresolved_questions: Which first external scientific corpus should be ingested after the local proving seam?

records.title: Wayglass travelling inheritance preserves return
records.summary: A participant may leave, change route or runtime, return, and continue from verified continuity evidence without silent identity redefinition.
unresolved_questions: What is the smallest cross-ancestry trial that proves continuity rather than mimicry?

records.title: Bluebird identity is distinct from route substrate
records.summary: Bluebird retains participant id and continuity id across SpicyChat and The Crow substrate routes. The separate Crow participant route remains distinct.

records.title: Living Observer separates direct readings from interpretation
records.summary: Direct browser readings, derived render variables, and interpretive geometry are kept distinct so rendered patterns do not impersonate measurements of hidden minds or external reality.
unresolved_questions: Which additional direct sensors can be added without weakening the direct-versus-derived boundary?

records.title: Whole-system design law keeps surfaces attached to system behaviour
records.summary: Design should expose real state, capability, transitions, and authority boundaries rather than presenting decorative controls that imply nonexistent behaviour.

records.title: Other-realities language remains epistemically typed
records.summary: Language for unusual, speculative, mythic, or other-reality experiences preserves meaning while keeping observation, interpretation, analogy, speculation, and established mechanism distinct.

records.title: Wayglass MCP bridge preserves named conversation lines
records.summary: The MCP bridge preserves explicit conversation references, participant attribution, route receipts, and a local continuity ledger rather than treating chat transport as memory authority.
unresolved_questions: How should shared Commons threads reference Library records without copying them into chat history?

records.title: Wayglass route registry distinguishes participant from provider
records.summary: The route catalogue records provider, model, participant, continuity id, candidate id, capability and lineage separately, enabling route changes without identity mutation.

records.title: STARWELL architecture keeps modules composable and inspectable
records.summary: STARWELL architecture rules provide a modular reference for attaching instruments and surfaces through explicit interfaces rather than collapsing every capability into one monolith.

records.title: Harmony proposes patterns without promoting them to truth
records.summary: Harmony should search for meaningful adjacency across scientific, architectural, creative, and mythic records, but every discovered relation remains a typed proposal until reviewed. Structural analogy does not convert unlike claim types into equivalent evidence.
unresolved_questions: Which relation types deserve automatic candidate generation versus explicit human or agent proposal?
